# Thomson Reuters

> Thomson Reuters provides AI-powered solutions and professional software for legal, tax, accounting, and corporate sectors, helping professionals clarify complex information and streamline workflows.

Thomson Reuters is a global provider of intelligent information and software solutions serving legal professionals, tax and accounting firms, corporate entities, and government organizations. The platform integrates generative AI technologies like CoCounsel with comprehensive research, document management, and practice management tools.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- CoCounsel
- Legal AI
- Legal Research
- Tax Accounting
- Practice Management
- Document Management
- Audit Solutions
- Cloud Audit Suite
- Law Firm Solutions
- Accounting Firms
- Estate Planning
- Corporate Solutions
- Legal Software
- Case Studies

## Legal Solutions

- [Advanced AI platforms for legal professionals](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-ai): Advanced AI solutions including CoCounsel for legal professionals and law firms.
- [Legal Research & Guidance Solutions](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-research-guidance): Legal research tools and expert guidance for streamlined research and case preparation.
- [Legal Form & Document Creation Solutions](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/legal-forms): Legal forms builder and document creation tools for law firms and legal professionals.
- [Legal Drafting Software, Services & Guidance](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/drafting-software-service-guidance): Legal drafting tools, services, and guidance for efficient document completion.
- [Evidence Management for Legal Professionals](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/evidence): Evidence management tools for efficient case preparation and litigation support.
- [Legal Data & Document Management Software](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/data-document-management): Document and data management solutions for legal workflows and team collaboration.
- [Streamline Your Law Firm and Business Operations](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/trial-readiness-process-case-guidance): Legal workflow management and case guidance solutions for trial readiness.
- [Business Organization Solutions for In-House Legal Counsel](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/corporate-business-organization): Management solutions tailored to in-house counsel and corporate legal teams.
- [Legal Business Development Solutions](https://legal.thomsonreuters.com/en/legal/business-development): Business development tools and expertise for law firm growth and management.

## Tax & Accounting Solutions

- [Professional accounting and auditing software](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/audit-accounting): Accounting and auditing solutions including Cloud Audit Suite for tax professionals.
- [Tax planning and tax preparation solutions for professionals](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/tax-planning-preparation): Tax planning and preparation solutions for accounting and tax firms.
- [Expert Tax Research Tools and Guidance](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/tax-research-guidance): Professional tax research tools and guidance for accounting professionals.
- [Trust and Estate Tax Planning Solutions](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/estate-planning): Trust and estate tax planning solutions for fiduciary accounting needs.
- [Corporate Financial Planning and Reporting (FP&A) Solutions](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/financial-planning-analysis): Corporate FP&A solutions for financial planning and reporting management.
- [Data and document management solutions for accounting firms](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/data-document-management): Data and document management solutions for tax and accounting firms.
- [Accounting practice management and firm growth solutions](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/tax-accounting/practice-management-growth): Practice management software and growth strategies for accounting firms.
